provisioning.scope: Install only on the offline release-engineering host; this assembler is not a node runtime dependency.
provisioning.inputs: Provide a canonical local source tree containing every prebuilt target artifact, a strict source spec, and a singly linked mode-0600 Ed25519 signing key outside that tree.
provisioning.output: Move the new deterministic .tar bundle to the target through the operator-controlled offline channel; never copy the signing key.
